title: Model library: browse, install and place 3D model packages; pack and sign them
description: In-app Models section listing registry model packages with thumbnail, licence and attribution; library-wide install into the shared blob store; placement into the active petal through the existing creation core (new PlaceStoredGlb command); per-petal credits by local join; and fe-ext model pack, which seals a folder of GLB files plus library.toml into a signed, verified model package. Registry search gains licence and preview fields; publish refuses model packages without a licence or with an empty attribution.
user_decisions: UD-1 build the in-app library first; registry content follows
UD-2 public domain, CC0 or attribution licences; app and registry listing show licence and attribution before attribution content is published
UD-3 outside publishers apply by web form; operator publishes on their behalf, signed by the publisher's own key; no approved-publisher list
UD-4 terrain content is a separate running lane, out of scope
recommended_decisions: D-1 pack command is fe-ext model pack (reversal low)
D-2 thumbnails supplied and required, PNG <= 256 KiB, <= 512x512 (reversal low)
D-3 install is library-wide on the device, placement is the role-gated step (reversal medium)
D-4 placement through new PlaceStoredGlb into import_gltf_handler's post-storage stage (reversal medium)
D-5 credits by local join, replicated provenance deferred (reversal low now)
D-6 licence required for model packages at pack and publish (reversal low)
D-7 install refuses a model package with no licence (reversal low)
open_questions: OQ-1 peers see 'Source not installed here' in v1 (default) or attribution must replicate now
OQ-2 browse requires the registry service /search; static catalogue tree not browsable in v1 (default)
